title: Hyper Cars Stunt Racing
description: Start your engines and explore a massive open world in Hyper Cars Stunt Racing! This fantastic 3D driving simulator gives you the complete freedom to tear through a sprawling city, complete high-stakes missions, and build the hyper-car of your dreams. Whether you are drifting through downtown traffic, catching massive air at the airport, or going head-to-head against a friend in local multiplayer!

title: Word Bubbles
description: Word Bubbles is a fun and colorful word puzzle game where you combine word pieces to complete words from different categories. Look at the topic, find the matching parts, and put them together to discover all the hidden words. Complete every word to finish the level!

title: Sortica
description:
Sortica is the ultimate tile matching and pattern sorting logic puzzle! Combining mechanics from tile games, block sorting, and brain teasers, Sortica challenges you to organize tiles into matching containers using strategy and logic.

Features:
- Addictive tile & pattern stacking
- Handcrafted brain training levels
- Stress-free offline play, no time limits
- Soothing visuals & relaxing audio

Love Tile Match or Block Sort? Play Sortica today!

title: Solitaire Story Tripeaks 7
description: The newest sequel in the Solitaire TriPeaks 7 series takes you on a world tour across 129 breathtaking destinations, from Austria to Idaho! Clear tri-peak card layouts, chase seasonal Card Collections, spin through Bingo and Digging mini-games, and climb the leaderboard for exclusive rewards. With 7,720 levels of classic solitaire fun and fresh challenges added regularly, a new adventure always awaits. Play now!

title: Twilight Onet Connect
description: Welcome to Twilight Onet Connect, the ultimate cozy Halloween tile-matching puzzle game that brings spooky charm, magical twilight nights, and enchanted fun straight to your screen!

title: Parkour Block Maker
description:
Welcome to Parkour Block Maker!

Play a growing collection of community-created parkour maps, create your own levels with the built-in level editor, and challenge other players to beat their high scores!

Create, play, and challenge yourself — the parkour adventure never ends! 
Caterson

title: Adopt a Monster
description: Merge spooky creatures and build your own monster collection in Adopt a Monster! Combine matching monsters to discover new forms, complete orders, and grow your collection in a cozy Halloween setting.

title: Mine Hunt Classic
description:
⭐ Mine Hunt Classic is a classic minesweeper experience where every move counts! ? Reveal the tiles, use the numbers to detect nearby mines, and carefully mark dangerous spots with flags. But be careful — one wrong move and BOOM!
Choose from Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulties, with different board sizes and mine counts.
Think ahead. Stay sharp. Hunt the mines!
⚡ Simple to play, challenging to master — Mine Hunt Classic brings the timeless minesweeper puzzle to your screen.

title: Fruit Blast
description: Dive into the juicy world of Fruit Blast! Match colorful fruits, create explosive combos, and complete exciting levels. Use powerful boosters, sharpen your puzzle skills, and enjoy a refreshing blast of fruity fun!

title: Looking For Aliens
description:
Curious about how aliens view our world? Looking for Aliens takes you on an unforgettable journey where you uncover the strange, funny, and sometimes absurd truth about life on Earth through extraterrestrial eyes. 

Explore each scene at your own pace, hunting for objects and uncovering hidden surprises. Need help? Use the built-in hints system to keep moving without losing the thrill of discovery.

title: Hot Pot Chef
description: Hotpot Shef is a relaxing food sorting puzzle and match-3 game where you sort tasty ingredients, match 3 identical items, complete food orders, and clear the hotpot. Choose ingredients carefully, organize the tray, solve each sorting puzzle, and complete every order in this fun casual cooking game.

title: Steal Animal Eggs Online
description: Steal Animal Eggs Online is a fast collection adventure where you raid nests, steal eggs, and escape guardians before returning to your base. Hatch 120+ animals across 12 rarity classes, train with 14 exercise machines to run faster, and explore 12 unique areas. Play online in 1 Player mode or locally with 2 players. Discover rare Gold, Diamond, Toxic, Lava, Rainbow, and Candy animals while building a valuable collection.

title: Macaron Sort
description: Put your sorting skills to the test in Macaron Sort! Move colorful macarons between trays and group matching flavors together. Plan each move carefully — only the bottom macaron in each tray can be moved. Complete every stack, unlock new challenges, and solve increasingly tricky puzzles!

title: Diamond Blast Egypt
description: Step into an ancient Egyptian puzzle adventure! Place colorful tile shapes on the board, complete full rows or columns, and clear them to earn points. Plan your moves carefully, create space for new pieces, and keep playing for as long as you can. How high can you score?

title: Fruity 2048
description: Swipe to combine matching fruit tiles and work your way up to 2048! Merge identical pairs into bigger fruits and see if you can reach the watermelon before the board fills up.

title: Blob Builders
description: Blob Builders is a cozy physics puzzle game set in a hand-drawn, old-time cartoon world. Drag sticky jelly blobs together to build bridges, towers and roads, then lead the survivors safely home. Build triangles for strong shapes and watch your creation wobble and sag. 45 levels in 9 worlds, plus a daily puzzle and a Blob Tower sandbox.

title: Hex Crash - Racing Game
description: Hex Crash is a car brawl on a floating floor of hexagons. Every tile you drive over drops away, and so does every tile your rivals touch. Ram them into the holes, dodge their dashes, fly over the gaps and be the last car standing. Grab the power fist on the middle pyramid, unlock 12 cars and climb from Bronze to Legend. Sound credits: tire squeal by Tom Haigh (audible-edge), CC-BY 3.0. Engine by domasx2, effects by Kenney (CC0).

title: Sky Isles: Flight SIM 3D
description: Sky Isles Flight Simulator is a 3D airplane game set over a chain of tropical islands. Start your engine, taxi to the runway, take off and fly from a small training plane all the way up to a passenger jet airliner. Every flight ends the same way: you have to land it yourself.
